tool.name: nf-core pureclip
tool.description: PureCLIP is a tool to detect protein-RNA interaction footprints from single-nucleotide CLIP-seq data, such as iCLIP and eCLIP.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ pureclip \ -i $ipbam \ -bai $ipbai \ -g $genome_fasta \ -nt ${task.cpus} \ -o $crosslinks_output_name \ -or $peaks_output_name \ ${control_bam} \ ${control_bai} \ ${args}
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": pureclip: \$(echo \$(pureclip --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*pureclip //; s/Using.*\$//; s/version: //; s/ Seq.*//' )) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
PureCLIP is a tool to detect protein-RNA interaction footprints from single-nucleotide CLIP-seq data, such as iCLIP and eCLIP.
